prompt_md: You break a stick at two points chosen at random along its length (independently, uniformly), giving three pieces. What's the chance the three pieces can form a triangle?
prompt_short: Break a stick at two random points. Chance the 3 pieces make a triangle?
hint_md: No piece can be half the stick or longer.
explain_intuition_md: Three pieces make a triangle only if none is half the stick or longer. Each piece has a 1-in-4 chance of being that long, and only one piece can be. So 3 times in 4 something is too long, leaving 1 in 4.
